promotions.name: Happy Hour Coffee
promotions.rule: 20% off any coffee category item purchased between 2pm and 4pm.

eligibility.notes: Applies automatically to coffee items ordered within the time window. Cannot be combined with other promotions.

promotions.name: Pastry + Coffee Combo
promotions.rule: Get any pastry for $1.50 off when purchased together with any coffee item in the same order.

eligibility.notes: Requires at least one coffee item and one pastry item in the same order.

promotions.name: Summer Smoothie Special
promotions.rule: Buy one smoothie, get a second smoothie 50% off.

eligibility.notes: Applies to the lower-priced of two smoothies in the same order. Seasonal promotion, currently expired.
